name: Ebru
summary: Above the Wailing Caverns, Ebru watches Naralex's dream turn to nightmare. A night elf druid and one of his few uncorrupted disciples, she calls on travelers to enter the depths and cull the mutated horrors born of the Nightmare.

sections.title: A Watch Above the Descent
sections.body:
Ebru keeps watch from a camp inside the cavernous skull above the Wailing Caverns' entrance. Most of Naralex's followers have fallen to the emerald corruption spreading through the caverns, but she escaped it.

Naralex hoped to draw on underground springs and make the arid Barrens a woodland. His plan has gone horribly wrong, and Ebru sees that dream become a nightmare. She urges willing travelers into the depths to kill the growing number of deviate beasts threatening the surrounding plains.

sections.title: The Price of Corruption
sections.body: The Nightmare has twisted the caves and Ebru's fellow disciples, making them the fanatical Druids of the Fang. Their companionship is gone, and her circle faces ruin. Ebru turns her efforts to containing the corruption.

faq.answer: Ebru is a night elf druid and one of Naralex's few uncorrupted disciples. She watches from a cave high above the Wailing Caverns' entrance and coordinates efforts to stem the corruption spreading into the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is Ebru located above the Wailing Caverns?
faq.answer: Ebru fled to the crag above the cave entrance when Naralex's ritual collapsed into the Emerald Nightmare and turned her fellow disciples into hostile zealots. From her perch, she watches the caverns and stays safe from the feral horrors inside.

faq.q: What happened to Naralex and his other disciples?
faq.answer: Naralex entered a deep trance to tap the underground springs, but his mind became trapped in the Emerald Nightmare. The corruption twisted the cave's plants and animals and drove most of his disciples mad, turning them into the Druids of the Fang.

faq.q: What does Ebru ask travelers to do?
faq.answer: Ebru urges travelers to enter the depths of the Wailing Caverns and cull the deviate beasts. She wants them to strike back against the mutated horrors born from her master's tormented dreams.

angles.text: For a druid of the Cenarion Circle, meeting Ebru is a stark reminder of the dangers of walking the Emerald Dream and the terrible cost of losing control.
As a night elf, Ebru shows that a small, isolated enclave of your people lives deep in Kalimdor's arid heart, far from the ancient boughs of Ashenvale and Teldrassil.
